summary: Evidence-backed appointment reconciliation with durable provider identity caching, configurable reminders, optional Calendar projection, and optional verified native spoken delivery.

writes: provider/entity alias and source binding state
native reminder delivery intent when enabled

conditional_capabilities.email-evidence: required only for email-driven ingestion; manual appointment state remains available without it
conditional_capabilities.calendar-projection: required only for transactions whose selected policy enables Calendar projection
conditional_capabilities.public-provider-research: best-effort enrichment when selected; cache and owner correction are preferred before repeat research
conditional_capabilities.notification-delivery: required only for native reminder projection
conditional_capabilities.spoken-notification: requires explicit opt-in plus verified native-client TTS/audio delivery; visual reminder paths remain independent

runtime_contract.idempotency_scope: appointment/source identity plus provider source binding and linked calendar event
